resources.title: Artificial Intelligence

resources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile

resources.title: arXiv Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

known_gaps: Foundation and beginner coverage remains intentionally limited for advanced subsubjects rather than mapping graduate material downward.
Dedicated symbolic reasoning, planning, robotics-AI and multi-agent curricula should be strengthened where taxonomy cells remain uncovered.
Research repositories do not by themselves establish expert readiness; item-level evidence review, runtime retrieval, provenance and assessment remain required.
NIST AI RMF 1.0 is under revision, so operational governance references must preserve version and retrieval date.
